independence_scope: Independent visual comparison against parent-selected runtime records; the reviewer authored the observer code and is not claiming independent source authorship review here.
verification_method: Viewed both retained screenshots directly; transcribed the final three displayed lengths and SHA-256 strings independently; compared those with selected JSON; recomputed local screenshot, selected-JSON and frozen-source hashes.

live_observation.scope: five workers were present in this sample; this is not a total-spawn count

supported_conclusions: The observer completed its diagnostic window and its recorded identity was absent at the final query. No tracked identities remained in its final selected output.

The new VM observation had a natural leader exit with status zero, ECHILD true, no recorded forced-QEMU cleanup, no recorded forced descendants and no cleanup errors. The earlier forced-descendant rejection did not recur in this run.
The saved-inspection outer owner still rejected with exit and owner_exit code two. Observer completion and clean VM cleanup do not release a saved-inspection success gate.
The live image establishes the displayed QEMU-to-factory-to-five-live-workers genealogy for these exact identities. It does not classify PID 13344 from the earlier run.
interpretation_limits: The maximum discovery interval of 237983.789323 ms is consistent with the intentional pause between the initial readiness self-probe and first bound owner observation. The code skips root discovery when no tracked target rows exist; the separately recorded owner launch was 16:00:47.836254 UTC. This is not evidence of a 238-second hole during the displayed native helper execution.
Zero sampling-gap events means no owned sampling interval crossed max(500 ms, three times the intended owned interval). It does not establish continuous 20-ms coverage or capture every transition.

Thirteen read-gap records and two unavailable root stat reads are explicit coverage limits. The compact final projection does not identify every read-gap cause, so the remaining gaps must not be labelled harmless shutdown races without reading their events.

All displayed live rows had kill_pending false at that sample. This does not establish whether SIGKILL was pending at another time. A pending signal mask alone cannot identify its sender or prove which request caused death.

A forced-descendant receipt records supervisor cleanup requests. A zombie snapshot or a process disappearing from /proc is separate observational evidence; absence supplies no exit status. Clean supervisor cleanup does not establish a normal zero exit status for every native descendant.
The observer heartbeat stops after finalization, so the displayed 69.405-second age accompanies a FINISHED status rather than a RUNNING heartbeat guarantee.
No cleanup implementation was changed. A non-recurrence under observation is not an established fix or proof of a counterfactual natural-reap grace period. The observer itself can alter scheduling.
PID 13344 from resume1 remains unclassified and its actual termination cause remains unknown.
